title: Quality Jute charger squares not napkins !!
text: Quality Jute charger squares not napkins !!. These are just ok for what they are and took longer than expected to arrive. They will serve my purpose for decoration on my guest tables for an Italian themed rehearsal dinner. They are not napkins they are stiff and more like a table top charger the purpose for my use. I would recommend the product they are quality but make sure you know what you are ordering and it’s use.

product_metadata.title: Park Designs Burlap Napkin
description: Burlap Napkin 18" Square Priced and sold as a set of 4. Burlap items provide the natural look of burlap, but with the softer touch of cotton. Designed and manufactured by Park Designs.
